sol-3-1.summary: Repository.directoryUrl throws URIError on an accepted directory containing a lone UTF-16 surrogate, in both the lab and pinned upstream oracle.
sol-3-1.fix: Wrap each encodeURIComponent call in Result.try, convert results through Result.getSuccess, and sequence with O.all; return None on encoding failure while preserving current URL and percent-encoding behavior. Add a Repository.test.ts regression proving successful decoding, non-throwing None, and unchanged wire round-trip fidelity. Supply an upstream-bug receipt and regression reference to central bookkeeping; do not edit PORT_LEDGER.json or README Port notes.

sol-3-2.summary: The known-field accumulator loses a declared __proto__ subclass field, causing Package.wireFor to fail decoding its own encoding in both the lab and pinned upstream oracle.
sol-3-2.fix: Construct known with R.fromEntries over R.toEntries(raw) filtered by knownKeys instead of assignment into {}; retain the existing rest representation and typed-field precedence, and correct the adjacent collision comment. Add a Package.test.ts regression using Package.extend with a computed __proto__: S.String field, covering direct class decoding, wire decoding, and encode/decode fidelity with other metadata preserved. Supply an upstream-bug receipt and regression reference to central bookkeeping; do not edit PORT_LEDGER.json or README Port notes.
